message.content:
[
  {
    "severity": "blocking",
    "file": "langfuse/openai.py",
    "line": 409,
    "failure_mode": "The prompt extraction logic for resource.type == \"chat\" and resource.type == \"embedding\" appears swapped. Chat now uses kwargs[\"input\"] while embedding uses _extract_chat_prompt(kwargs).",
    "impact": "For chat requests, prompt will often be None because chat APIs typically provide messages rather than input; for embedding requests, attempting to extract a chat prompt may fail or return None. This breaks prompt capture/telemetry and any downstream logic relying on it.",
    "suggested_fix": "Restore the original logic: for resource.type == \"chat\" use prompt = _extract_chat_prompt(kwargs); for resource.type == \"embedding\" use prompt = kwargs.get(\"input\", None)."
  },
  {
    "severity": "should-fix",
    "file": "langfuse/openai.py",
    "line": 543,
    "failure_mode": "Token detail keys were changed from singular to plural (input_token_details/output_token_details -> input_tokens_details/output_tokens_details), dropping support for the previous key names.",
    "impact": "If upstream or older SDKs provide singular keys, token details will be silently ignored, reducing observability and causing partial usage data in production.",
    "suggested_fix": "Support both variants by iterating over all four keys or normalizing: for key_aliases in ((\"input_tokens_details\",\"input_token_details\"), (\"output_tokens_details\",\"output_token_details\")) use the first present key, then process its value."
  }
]
